title: 天上掉下来的石头
subtitle: 流星、陨石和彗星
character: wearing a navy hoodie, dark trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in two-colour screenprint style on deep midnight blue, flat cream and pale gold shapes with visible ink texture, bold and simple, flat and graphic, not a photograph and not a realistic space rendering

pages.zh:
夏天的晚上，
我和爸爸躺在院子里看星星。
忽然，天上划过一道光，
一下子就没了。
那是什么掉下来了吗？
pages.scene: The little boy lies on a blanket in a yard at night looking up at the sky, pointing upward with one arm.

pages.zh:
那道光叫「流星」。
可它不是星星。
它只是一小块石头，
大多还没有一颗豆子大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small rough stone in the middle of a dark background with one bright streak of light drawn behind it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
太空里飘着很多这样的小石头，
是行星形成的时候
剩下的碎渣。
它们一直在绕着太阳跑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sun at the left of a dark background with several small stones spread along a wide curved path around it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地球也在跑，
一秒钟就跑三十公里。
两边一撞，
小石头冲进空气的时候，
快得不可思议。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one earth ball on a dark background moving to the right with a bold arrow, and one small stone arriving toward it from the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它冲进空气，
把前面的空气挤得又热又亮。
石头被烧得发光，
我们看到的那道光，
其实是发亮的空气。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small stone entering a band of air on a dark background, with a glowing bright wedge in front of it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大多数流星
在离地面很高的地方
就烧完了，
变成一点点灰，
慢慢飘下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dark background with a ground line at the bottom, a high dashed line far above it, and one streak that stops at the dashed line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
个子大一点的烧不完，
就会落到地上。
落到地上的那块石头，
改名字了，
叫陨石。
pages.scene: One dark rough stone lying on bare ground at night on a dark background, a little pit around it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有时候一晚上
能看到很多流星，
那叫流星雨。
因为地球正好穿过
一条布满尘粒的路。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one earth ball on a dark background crossing a wide band of small dust specks, several streaks appearing on the side facing the band. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这条路是彗星留下的。
彗星是一个脏雪球，
冰里裹着尘土。
它绕太阳跑一圈，
要很多很多年。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round icy ball made of pale cream flecks on a dark background, with small dust specks trailing behind it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
彗星靠近太阳的时候，
冰被晒化，
气和尘土一起喷出来，
在后面拉出长长的尾巴，
尾巴总是背着太阳。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one sun at the left of a dark background and one comet at the right with a long tail pointing away from the sun. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
月亮上没有空气，
小石头一路都不会被烧掉，
所以它表面
全是大大小小的坑。
地球上也有几个陨石坑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one moon surface across a dark background with many round craters of different sizes on it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
又一道光划过去。
爸爸说，可以许个愿。
我知道那只是一块小石头，
可我还是闭上眼睛，
许了一个。
pages.scene: The little boy lies on the blanket at night with his eyes closed and hands together, a faint streak of light in the sky above.
